items.title: How Grimes’ Cameo in Theater-Bound AI Film ‘Gods Don’t Give Gifts’ Came Together (EXCLUSIVE)
items.excerpt: Grimes lends her likeness and real voice to a minutes-long cameo in Zack London's (Gossip Goblin) 'Gods Don't Give Gifts', billed as the first AI feature set to debut in U.S. theaters in December.

items.title: AI Movie ‘Gods Don’t Give Gifts’ Gets Serious with AI-Generated Grimes Cameo, Times Square Marketing Push, Oscar Screenings
items.excerpt: The AI-generated sci-fi anthology adds an AI-rendered Grimes cameo, a Times Square ad campaign and awards-qualifying screenings ahead of its theatrical run.

items.title: ‘Blade Runner 2049’ Producer Settles Lawsuit Against Warner Bros. Discovery Over AI Images
items.excerpt: Alcon Entertainment settled its claims that Warner Bros. Discovery helped Elon Musk create unlicensed Blade Runner 2049-style promo images with an AI image generator; Alcon continues to pursue Musk and Tesla.

items.title: You can edit your videos with AI on Instagram’s new desktop Edits app
items.excerpt: Instagram's Edits video editor comes to desktop with a full timeline and AI agent-driven editing (Meta's Muse) for Reels.

items.title: AI movies make leap from short clips to big screen
items.excerpt: The fully AI-generated Korean sci-fi feature 'Raphael' opens in local theaters Nov. 25 after 14 months of editing to keep characters consistent, following 'Steelay' last month; Yeon Sang-ho and Jia Zhangke weigh in on human authorship.

items.title: “멍멍이 둘이 할리우드 접수?”…AI 강아지 콤비, 조회수 15억 돌파에 워너브러더스까지 러브콜
items.excerpt: DogPack's AI-generated character duo Goldie & Frenchie passed 1.5 billion social views and, now repped by a major Hollywood agency, are collaborating with Warner Bros. as standalone entertainment IP.

items.title: Remington Scott to Lead Eros Innovation's New AI Creative Unit
items.excerpt: Eros Innovation launches an AI creative unit for VFX, digital humans and gaming, led by mocap veteran Remington Scott, with a Mohammed Rafi digital-human project among its first priorities.

items.title: iZotope Intros Photon for AI-Powered Stem Separation and Denoising
items.excerpt: iZotope's Photon is a standalone app and ARA plugin using 12 custom-trained machine-learning models for stem separation and dialogue/audio enhancement, processed locally on the GPU for post-production.

items.title: DaVinci Resolve 21.2: new features and fixes
items.excerpt: Resolve 21.2 adds Gen 6 LUTs, MacBook Pro touchscreen support and 25+ fixes, while the Studio edition gets more AI assistant tools.

items.title: “We’re not afraid of AI,” says GIFF Pro’s Mathieu Gayet as 2026 programme opens
items.excerpt: GIFF Pro head Mathieu Gayet says the Geneva festival's industry arm is 'not afraid of AI' as its 2026 programme opens, positioning the event to engage with AI-driven work.

items.title: CAA's Bryan Lourd Discusses AI As Agency Weighs In On NYT Vs. OpenAI Battle
items.excerpt: Hollywood agency CAA, with big-name clients on board, weighs in on the New York Times' AI-training lawsuit against OpenAI, and Bryan Lourd discusses the agency's position on AI.

items.title: AI Dubbing Pioneer Flawless Sells Tech To Steven Schuurman Venture
items.excerpt: Flawless, which spent $100M building SAG-AFTRA-endorsed TrueSync visual-dubbing tech used on films like 'Fall', has sold its IP after its UK entity entered administration.

items.title: Matti Klemm sues Netflix over AI training on his voice
items.excerpt: Jason Momoa's German dub voice Matti Klemm is suing Netflix, backed by the German voice-artists association VDS, after a data request showed his dubbing recordings were used to train AI.

items.title: Kling 4.0 Flash Opens Web, API, and Adobe Plugin Access
items.excerpt: Per Kling's Nov. 4 announcement, Kling 4.0 Flash is now open on web and API with connections into Adobe apps, letting editors call the video model from inside existing post workflows.

items.title: Pitch Black Expands REVIZE AI Globally Across its Studios
items.excerpt: Pitch Black rolls its REVIZE AI/machine-learning VFX toolset, used on 'Sinners' and 'Mickey 17', out across all its global studios.

items.title: Animaj unveiled FlipMove, an artist-led AI animation workflow
items.excerpt: Animaj's proprietary FlipMove workflow, already used on preschool series 'Ozzy Fox', uses AI to accelerate animation production while keeping animators in creative control.

items.title: View Conference’s AI Sales Pitches Were Exhausting
items.excerpt: At Turin's View Conference, filmmakers shared craft while AI evangelists claimed everyone already uses the technology; Cartoon Brew reports the pitches and their gaps.
